Jae (CSM): Heads-up — Quantifyly just flagged for downgrade risk. Renewal in 26 days and usage has dropped 42% month-over-month. They hit two integration errors last week.

Priya (CS Ops): Thx Jae. Do we have the onboarding checklist completion state?

Jae (CSM): 4/7 enablement sessions done, SLOs not configured, billing pinged about invoice dispute (pending). I captured notes in the account doc: https://redwood.internal/quantifyly/notes

Lily (CS Manager): Ok — let's spin up a 72-hour winback + downgrade-safety path. We should prioritize quick wins that show value without engineering lift.

Marco (RevOps): Agree. From pricing side: offer a 3-month temporary credit + discounted Dedicated slot if they commit to a success plan. But only after CS team validates product fit.

Kofi (Onboarding Eng): I can run a fast health sweep for their integration errors tomorrow. Will check logs, KV cache mismatch, and provide a patch doc. ETA 24h.

Cleo (Support): I can escalate the two error cases and add a follow-up SLA. Are there any support errors blocked on infra?

Jae (CSM): One blocked on model routing fallback — infra said it was transient. I logged trace id: 0x9af3c2. Kofi pls correlate.

Priya (CS Ops): Drafting a save plan template below — propose we use this as playbook and track in Gainsight. Please comment.

Priya (CS Ops): === 72-Hour Winback + Downgrade Path ===
1) Day 0: Outreach & triage
  - Owner: Jae
  - Action: 15-min discovery call, confirm pain, escalate top 2 blockers
  - Deliverable: Call notes + prioritized 2-issue list
2) Day 1: Technical triage & quick fixes
  - Owner: Kofi + Cleo
  - Action: Run health sweep, apply config patch or workaround, confirm restored flows
  - Deliverable: Health report + workaround steps
3) Day 2: Value reframe + low-effort enablement
  - Owner: Jae + Kofi
  - Action: Run a 30-min workshop showing top 3 ROI dashboards, enable prefix/KV caching to reduce latency
  - Deliverable: Workshop recording + checklist
4) Day 3: Commercial offer & commit
  - Owner: Marco
  - Action: Present temporary credit & Dedicated discount; collect verbal commit or formal downgrade request
  - Deliverable: Signed brief or downgrade plan
Fallbacks:
  - If errors persist: temporary routing to fallback model + 72-hr SLA credit
  - If customer requests downgrade: propose staged downgrade with migration runbook

Priya (CS Ops): Also adding a quick feedback-capture snippet to use during the call: 
"""
Hi <name>, quick Q: what outcome would make Redwood indispensable for you in 30 days?
Choose 1: a) 30% faster responses b) 50% lower token cost c) consistent accuracy on our prompts
Any blockers we should prioritize?
"""

Lily (CS Manager): Love the structure. Add a required executive touchpoint on Day 2 if they are enterprise tier.

Marco (RevOps): Email template for the offer (short):

Subject: Redwood help proposal — short-term credit + success plan

Hi <FirstName>,

Thanks for working through the issues. To make sure you see value immediately, we'd like to offer a 3-month credit of $X and a discounted Dedicated slot if you commit to a success plan.

Can we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow to walk the plan?

Best,
Marco

Jae (CSM): Can somebody own scheduling the workshop? I can run the value demo if Kofi confirms fixes.

Kofi (Onboarding Eng): I can block 2–3pm PST tomorrow for the sweep. If fixes are trivial, I can join the workshop at 4pm.

Cleo (Support): I'll create two follow-up tickets and set 4h SLA for initial triage, link them to the account.

Priya (CS Ops): I'll open a Gainsight playbook entry and set tasks + reminders. Also adding a downgrade migration checklist:
- export prompts
- snapshot model configs
- validate embeddings compatibility
- schedule final sync call

Lily (CS Manager): Ok owners: Jae (outreach), Kofi (tech), Marco (offer), Cleo (support), Priya (ops). Please update status in the thread as you complete each step.

Jae (CSM): I'll do outreach now. Quick note — use this one-off email for exec intro: 

"Hi <ExecName>,
Quick note — our team is personally owning Quantifyly's success this week. Jae (CSM) and Kofi (Onboarding Eng) will run a technical sweep and demo tomorrow. Can you spare 15 minutes for an exec sync?
"

Marco (RevOps): If they decline to commit, plan B = staged downgrade: reduce Dedicated hours, enable caching and short retention window; provide migration support and 30-day reduced cost.

Kofi (Onboarding Eng): Sweep started — pulling logs now (trace id: 0x9af3c2). Will post findings.

Cleo (Support): Tickets created: #SUP-4621, #SUP-4622. Linking both to Quantifyly.

Priya (CS Ops): Gainsight playbook created: https://gainsight.redwood/plays/1779009999 (let me know if you need edit access)

Jae (CSM): Outcome update (1779010200) — exec agreed to 15m tomorrow, Kofi found config mismatch in model routing, patch applied, workshop scheduled 4pm PST. Moving to Day 2.

Lily (CS Manager): Great. Keep this thread updated. After Day 3 we'll capture a short case study if they renew. :tada:
